visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail wearing a grey vest over a white blouse stands in front of a white wall. She holds a large teal-colored cookie tin and a smaller yellow tin. A clear glass of tea sits on the table in front of her. (2) She reaches into a large teal paper bag and pulls out the teal cookie tin, showcasing the 'GIN NO MORI' branding. (3) The scene shifts to a retail storefront with a large tree-trunk decoration and blue signage. People are seen walking in a busy urban plaza in front of a modern glass skyscraper. (4) Back in the indoor setting, she points to the teal tin's contents: an assortment of various cookies, nuts, and meringues in shades of brown, green, and pink. A close-up shows a printed price list with cookie diagrams. (5) She presents the smaller yellow tin, identifying it as a limited edition. (6) She opens the teal tin, removes a protective white paper, and reacts with surprise and delight to the visual arrangement. (7) She picks up an acorn-shaped cookie and takes a bite. Subsequent close-ups show different types of cookies: a white-powdered nut cookie, a long sandwich cookie with red filling, and a round almond cookie. (8) She opens the yellow tin to reveal colorful small meringue balls and tastes several of them. (9) Finally, she holds both tins again, pointing at them while delivering her final recommendation.
